title: Customer-facing roles per research or engineering role
subtitle: Open sales, support and applied AI roles for every research or engineering role. Higher means more of the hiring faces customers.
takeaway: Anthropic lists 1.1 customer-facing roles for every research or engineering role; peers range from 0.2 to 3.0.
assumptions: Ratio = (go-to-market & support + applied AI & solutions) ÷ (research & modeling + engineering & product), by the function rules on the function chart.
A high ratio means more of the hiring is selling and deploying than building. It is a mix indicator, not a quality judgement.
Counts postings listed on each company's own job board in the weekly snapshot. Boards list roles, not headcount: one posting can fill several seats, and a company can leave roles unlisted.
Google DeepMind is missing: it posts only on Google's careers site, which has no public API.
